title: Console bell and approvals badge keep polling every 60 s for the first 10 minutes of a hidden tab
body:
domain:ui#4 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh

Filing gate: ③ ruling-directed. Ruling B on #26676 (6520722066) fixes a new card under #26676 as the remedy for a finding after a landing. Found by the post-merge proxy preview review of PR #27907 (#27626): comment 6522108365, on `main` `18318361`, `examples/app-crm`, 1440×900, evidence branch `claude/issue-27626-proxy-evidence` @ `4c9afa65`. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Business reason
Who: every console reader who leaves tabs open in the background. What happens: a hidden tab polls as often as a visible one for its first ten minutes, so the background load #27626 meant to cut stays.

## Observed
- Expected (#27626 Target 4): the bell's feeds pause in hidden tabs.
- On `main`, the inbox and approvals feeds keep polling every 60 s while the tab is hidden. They stop only after 10 minutes of continuous hiding: objectui#12439's `HIDDEN_POLL_MS` 60 s and `HIDDEN_POLL_STOP_MS` 10 min, which #27907 left unchanged.
- #27907 moved the foreground cadence to 60 s. So for the first 10 minutes, a hidden tab now polls no less than a visible one.
- This is not a regression from #27907. The sentence "still stop in a hidden tab" in its PR body and changeset is inaccurate.
- Surface: any console page (for example `/apps/com.example.crm/crm_contact`), idle, no drawer, 1440 px. Evidence logs 12, 19, 20 and 29.

## Wanted
A hidden tab stops the bell's and the approvals badge's polling, or polls clearly less often than a visible one. It reads once when the tab becomes visible again. Measure first why objectui#12439 kept a 10-minute hidden window. If that was a ruling, this card is `needs_decision`.

## Acceptance
- [ ] With the tab hidden, the feeds make no poll, or polls at the agreed hidden cadence, from the moment it hides. Pinned with fake timers and `visibilitychange`.
- [ ] On becoming visible, one read per feed.
